articles.title: Moody’s affirms Medline at Ba1, sees post-IPO deleveraging driving upgrade path
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Moody's Ratings revised its outlook on Medline Inc (NASDAQ:MDLN) to positive from stable on Monday, signaling potential for a credit upgrade over the next 12 to 18 months. The ratings agency simultaneously affirmed the medical supply giant’s Ba1 corporate family rating, along with its Ba1 backed senior secured facilities and Ba2 senior unsecured notes.
